title: 安全柜里的双层装袋（国内版）
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/28_BIOLOGICAL SAFETY CABINETS WASTE DISPOSAL.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/28_BIOLOGICAL SAFETY CABINETS WASTE DISPOSAL（国内版）/src.py

points.S1: 乙醇易燃，柜内不用明火

shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物安全柜旁，柜内有套袋的废物桶和蓝色喷壶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet with a lined waste bin and a blue spray bottle inside, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天学：安全柜里怎么双层装袋。

shots.scene: 阿杰做完细胞实验，柜内废物桶已经装了大半
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes a cell culture experiment; the lined waste bin inside the cabinet is more than half full.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完实验，废物桶快满了。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一盏酒精灯想放进柜里，小研摆手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a small alcohol burner to put in the cabinet; the female graduate student waves her hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 他想点上酒精灯再收拾，小研拦住了。

shots.scene: 小研拿起喷壶，示意阿杰看着
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up the spray bottle and gestures for him to watch.
shots.narration: 小研说：跟着我，一步一步来。

shots.scene: 柜内台面：套好两层袋的桶和喷壶
shots.prompt_en: On the cabinet work surface stand a bin fitted with two bags and a disinfectant spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 废物在柜里装好袋，再拿出来。

shots.scene: 柜前气流把污染挡在柜内的示意箭头
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show the airflow at the cabinet front keeping contamination inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里有气流保护，污染不外跑。

shots.scene: 小研拿喷壶对自己的手套喷洒
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet, the female graduate student sprays disinfectant onto her gloved hands.
shots.narration: 动手收口前，先喷一喷手套，

shots.scene: 喷壶对废物桶外侧喷洒
shots.prompt_en: The spray bottle mists the outside of the waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 废物容器的外面，也喷上。

shots.scene: 乙醇瓶图标和计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank ethanol disinfectant bottle icon next to a timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 常用乙醇消毒剂，种类按规程选。

shots.scene: 双手收拢内袋口，提起
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands gather the top of the inner bag and lift it gently. No people.
shots.narration: 把内袋口收拢，轻轻提起，

shots.scene: 袋口拧成一股
shots.prompt_en: The inner bag top twisted into a neck. No people.
shots.narration: 拧成一股，别挤压袋子。

shots.scene: 扎带扎住，再缠一圈胶带
shots.prompt_en: A zip tie tightened around the bag neck, then a band of tape wrapped over it. No people.
shots.narration: 扎带扎住，再缠上胶带。

shots.scene: 喷壶对着扎好的内袋和周围台面喷洒
shots.prompt_en: The spray bottle mists the tied inner bag and the surrounding work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 扎好以后，表面再喷一遍。

shots.scene: 手套接触过的扎口位置被标出
shots.prompt_en: Highlighted spots on the tied neck where the gloves touched it. No people.
shots.narration: 手碰过的地方，最容易沾污染。

shots.scene: 双手从桶沿翻起外袋
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands lift the outer bag up from the rim of the bin. No people.
shots.narration: 然后翻起外袋，

shots.scene: 外袋把内袋整个包住
shots.prompt_en: The outer bag closes completely around the tied inner bag. No people.
shots.narration: 把内袋整个包进去。

shots.scene: 外袋口同样用扎带和胶带扎好
shots.prompt_en: The outer bag neck is twisted and secured with a zip tie and tape. No people.
shots.narration: 同样用扎带和胶带扎紧。

shots.scene: 两层袋两道扎口的剖面示意
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a bag inside a bag, each with its own tied neck. No people.
shots.narration: 两道口，一层破了还有一层。

shots.scene: 小研提出双层废物袋，袋面有生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the double bag out of the bin; the bag carries a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 把双层袋从桶里提出来。

shots.scene: 喷壶对废物袋外表面喷洒
shots.prompt_en: Disinfectant is sprayed over the whole outside of the tied bag. No people.
shots.narration: 袋子外面喷消毒剂，

shots.scene: 小研倾斜空桶，喷桶外壁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tilts the empty bin and sprays its outer wall.
shots.narration: 空桶外壁也不放过。

shots.scene: 消毒后的袋子被移出柜外
shots.prompt_en: The disinfected bag is carried out through the cabinet front opening. No people.
shots.narration: 表面消毒后，再移出柜外。

shots.scene: 废物袋放进带盖转运箱，箭头指向高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The bag goes into a lidded transport box with a biohazard warning sign, with an arrow to an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这些废物，要高压灭菌。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开一本空白封面的实验室生物安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a laboratory biosafety manual with a blank cover and points to a page.
shots.narration: 怎么灭菌，按本室生物安全手册。

shots.scene: 阿杰跟着王老师在灭菌器前登记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes in a blank log beside the autoclave while the safety administrator watches.
shots.narration: 灭菌要登记，由培训过的人操作。

shots.scene: 柜内只剩空桶和喷壶，台面整洁
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet only the empty bin and the spray bottle remain on a clean work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 收尾时，柜里只留必需的东西。

shots.scene: 前窗缓缓放下
shots.prompt_en: The front glass sash of the cabinet slides down. No people.
shots.narration: 台面擦干净，放下前窗。

shots.scene: 柜内紫外灯亮着，柜前无人
shots.prompt_en: A violet ultraviolet lamp glows inside the closed cabinet; nobody stands in front of it. No people.
shots.narration: 紫外灯只作辅助，开灯时人离开。

shots.section_title: 乙醇易燃，柜内不用明火
shots.scene: 柜内点燃的酒精灯，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lit alcohol burner inside a biological safety cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜里，不点酒精灯。
overlay: 乙醇易燃，柜内不用明火

shots.section_title: 乙醇易燃，柜内不用明火
shots.scene: 火焰扰乱气流的示意，气流箭头变乱
shots.prompt_en: A small flame with the cabinet airflow arrows bending and swirling around it. No people.
shots.narration: 明火会扰乱气流，还可能起火。

shots.section_title: 乙醇易燃，柜内不用明火
shots.scene: 乙醇瓶旁标着易燃图标
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle next to a flammable warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 喷了乙醇的台面，更怕火。

shots.section_title: 乙醇易燃，柜内不用明火
shots.scene: 接种环放进小型电热灭菌器的图标
shots.prompt_en: An inoculating loop placed into a small electric loop sterilizer, or a box of disposable loops. No people.
shots.narration: 要灭菌接种环，用电热或一次性的。

shots.section_title: 乙醇易燃，柜内不用明火
shots.scene: 乙醇瓶盖好放回柜外，远离热源
shots.prompt_en: A capped disinfectant bottle stored outside the cabinet away from a hot plate icon. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醇用完盖好，远离热源。

shots.scene: 三个不同颜色的废物容器并排
shots.prompt_en: Three different waste containers side by side: a biohazard bag bin, a sharps container and a lidded chemical waste bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 装袋之前，废物先分类。

shots.scene: 针头被丢进软袋，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A needle being dropped into a soft waste bag, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器不进袋，进利器盒。

shots.scene: 化学试剂瓶倒进生物废物袋，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A chemical reagent bottle emptied into a biohazard waste bag, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化学废液，不混进生物废物袋。

shots.scene: 小研看废物分类指引海报
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a waste sorting chart made of pictograms on the wall.
shots.narration: 拿不准的，看指引或问老师。

shots.scene: 废物袋堆在走廊里，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Waste bags piled in a corridor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 出柜的废物，不能随手堆放。

shots.scene: 带锁的暂存间，门上有生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A lockable waste storage room door with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 放进专门的暂存区或转运箱。

shots.scene: 转运箱上贴空白标签，日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A lidded transport box with a blank label and a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 贴好标签，写明来源和日期。

shots.scene: 老李推着密闭转运车离开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wheels a closed waste cart away along a marked route.
shots.narration: 按时清运，不长时间存放。

shots.scene: 小研张开双手检查手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student spreads her gloved hands and inspects them.
shots.narration: 喷了乙醇，也要看看手套。

shots.scene: 手套指尖有小裂口，红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A glove fingertip with a small tear, marked with a red exclamation icon. No people.
shots.narration: 发现破口或明显沾污，

shots.scene: 在柜内脱下外层手套丢进废物袋，换上新手套
shots.prompt_en: Outer gloves are peeled off inside the cabinet into a waste bag and a fresh pair is put on. No people.
shots.narration: 先在柜内脱下，换上新的。

shots.scene: 皮肤上有伤口的示意，箭头指向报告
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a scratch on the skin with an arrow to a reporting icon. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤碰到了，冲洗后报告老师。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现喷手套、两道扎口的图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a sprayed glove and two tied bag necks.
shots.narration: 先喷手套，两层袋两道口。

shots.scene: 表面消毒、高压灭菌器、手册图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of spraying a bag surface, an autoclave and a manual with a blank cover. No people.
shots.narration: 表面消毒再出柜，按手册灭菌。

shots.scene: 打叉的酒精灯和分类废物桶图标
shots.prompt_en: A crossed-out alcohol burner icon next to three sorted waste containers. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内不用明火，废物分类收集。

shots.scene: 暂存间和换手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a waste storage room door and a fresh pair of gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 暂存及时清运，手套破了就换。

shots.scene: 欣欣、小研和阿杰在整洁的安全柜前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the young male student stand in front of a clean biological safety cabinet and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 装好袋，收好尾，下次见！
